evidence: profile-file-root-only: baseline openvpn_nm_connection.pp:31-34 declares file /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/${connection_name} with mode 0600, owner root, group root; stat on .../p8test-vpn expecting 'root root 600' tests exactly that for title p8test-vpn

vpn-settings-from-the-parameters: connection_file.erb:8-23 renders connection-type=password, dev-type=tap, remote=@remote, cipher=@cipher, username=@vpn_username, ca=@ca_crt; under the params fixture (remote 203.0.113.50, vpn_username p8testuser, ca_crt /etc/p8test-vpn/ca.crt, cipher at its .pp:15 default AES-256-CBC) the expected sorted vpn.data keys are exactly those values; mismatch varies only the connection name to one with no profile, which must change nmcli's verdict

uuid-is-the-stable-version-5-uuid-of-the-name: .pp:29 seeds the UUID with $connection_name; the ruled upstream_defects.md change replaces fqdn_rand_uuid with stdlib fqdn_uuid(same seed); I computed uuid5(NAMESPACE_DNS,'p8test-vpn') = df2d3b4d-5aa3-564f-92d4-fd9bac9644f9, the expected value for both the file's uuid= line (erb:3) and nmcli connection.uuid; mismatch changes only the nmcli connection name
